_comment: Profile A: a Java adapter JAR plus the vendor's JDBC driver, run by the
Java language container. Most connectors push queries down as IMPORT FROM
JDBC, which the database's loader runs with a separately registered copy
of the driver; a connector with "etl": null (BigQuery) returns VALUES.
On Exasol Personal the deployment exposes /exa at
<bucket>/ are read by SQL at /buckets/<service>/<bucket>/, and a loader
driver lives in jdbc/<DRIVERNAME>/ with its settings.cfg. Registering a NEW
loader driver takes effect on the next database start, so a plan that adds
one asks for one restart and batches everything else into it.
label: A
